Street Smarts.name: Street Smarts
Street Smarts.description:
🌃 You know how the city's underside works.

🧭 You know who sells what, which streets belong to whom and when to walk away.
📋 Requires level 8 and Streetwise 8.

📈 Grants: Streetwise +10
Street Smarts.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has spent enough time in the city's rough corners to read them: they spot gang territory, recognize a broker's front business, pick up useful rumors in back-alley bars and arcades and notice when a deal is a trap. Show it as quiet caution and the right question to the right person. Limits: knowing the street is not being trusted by it; the underworld still lies, and organized villains keep their secrets from small-time contacts. Heroes and police may read this familiarity as a sign of criminal ties.
